PROP-lean-slashing-002.text: The decidable surround-vote checker must flag exactly the validators with a surrounding source-target attestation pair (S2)
PROP-lean-slashing-002.assertion: slashed_surround_vote_iff_bex guarantees [slashedB st v = true ↔ ∃ a1 ∈ st.votes, ∃ a2 ∈ st.votes, surround_vote v a1 a2] with no must-establish preconditions; audit context: slashedB_S2(st,v) <-> exists a1,a2 by v with source(a1)<source(a2) and target(a2)<target(a1)
